text:
olivia: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands. Posting a brief Q&A recap, links, and owners for follow-ups. :wave:

raj: Quick ask — can you clarify Dedicated GA timeline? I heard 'Q3' but want exact dates for sales materials.

olivia: Good question. Dedicated GA target = 2025-09-15 for general availability, docs + pricing published on that day. Sales enablement kit to go out one week prior. (I'll add links below)

carlos: Noted — will we have a TOFU slide deck + one-pager?

olivia: Yes. @carlos take the one-pager, @sam will own the slide deck. I'll share a Notion template.

mei: Ops clarification from infra: Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) roadmap — is the on-prem air-gapped option still Oct?

anna: Short answer: on-prem GA is scoped for 2025-11-01 but may be gated on a few compliance certs. We're tracking the certs as blockers.

mei: Can you list the certs we depend on? I'll map compliance work in the schedule.

anna: Primary: SOC2+ISO27001 baseline. Secondary: FedRAMP assessment (customer-driven). I'll add the cert list to the GH issue.

raj: There was a question about default observability retention in Redwood Console — engineering asked for the default retention window for traces/logs.

mei: Current default = 30d for traces, 90d for aggregated metrics. Longer windows are an add-on. We plan a config toggle for teams to change retention per-organization by GA.

raj: Perfect. I'll update the public FAQ.

sam: Action: I'll draft the Dedicated GA press blurb and drop in #marketing by EOD Friday.

carlos: Action: I'll prepare the sales 1-pager and pricing sheet. Target: 2025-09-08.

olivia: Action: I'll create the Notion workspace for AH artifacts + template links. ETA: tomorrow. Link: https://notion.redwood.internal/allhands/2025-09-recap (internal)

deploy-bot: deploy_log: production/docs -> v1.23.0 scheduled 2025-09-08 02:00 UTC

raj: Someone asked if Dedicated will support model pinning + automatic fallback to hosted variants out of the box.

mei: Yes — model pinning will be supported. Fallback policy (hosted->compatible-quantized variant) will be configurable; default is disabled for Dedicated to respect data isolation. We'll add a how-it-works doc.

olivia: Note to PMs: add explicit UX copy for fallback behavior in the console so customers understand isolation trade-offs.

anna: Pricing guidance question in Q&A: is there a recommended starter config for a mid-market team?

olivia: Recommend: 2x A100-equivalent nodes reserved, burst pool enabled, and KV-cache enabled. Ballpark: see internal pricing sheet (will be attached).

carlos: I'll include a sample TCO calc in the sales sheet with those defaults.

raj: Request from product: we need a public roadmap blurb for "Optimize" features (batching suggestions, quantization hints). Can we get one-liners for the marketing page?

sam: I'll draft 3 bullets and share in #marketing for edits.

olivia: Operational ask: who will track the open action items? Prefer a single source of truth in Notion + assign owners.

sam: I'll maintain the action list. Will put owners + due dates.

carlos: Two smaller asks from customers — 1) more granular token cost breakdowns per-route, 2) alert when evals regress by >5%.

olivia: Both good. @eng-ml, please prioritize eval regression alerting as P1 for next sprint. Token breakdown is P2 but slated for the console roadmap.

mei: I'll add the alerting ticket: GH #4283. ETA for first pass: 2025-09-22.

raj: Can we schedule a short follow-up sync focused on Dedicated GA risks? 30 mins next Monday?

olivia: Yes. Scheduling poll: https://cal.com/olivia/dedicated-risk-sync — please pick a slot.

sam: For transparency, I'll post the follow-up notes in #all-hands and tag owners after the sync.

olivia: Recap of immediate action owners: sam (marketing assets & Notion), carlos (sales one-pager & pricing), mei (infra retention + GH ticket for alerts), anna (compliance cert list in GH), raj (FAQ updates).

olivia: If you asked a question during AH and don't see it covered here, DM me or reply to this thread and I'll add it.

sam: tiny follow-up — recorded all-hands video link: https://videos.redwood.internal/ah-2025-09-15 (internal)

carlos: thanks all :thumbsup:

olivia: Closing thread — will update Notion + ping owners. :white_check_mark:
